components: Immutable events remain addressable by partition and offset.
A checkpoint, timestamp, or offset selects the restart position.
Compatible code and schemas deterministically reprocess events.
Outputs are deduplicated, overwritten by version, or written separately.
Replay reaches the live head before normal consumption resumes.
